record.paper_title: Some open problems on best approximation in normed linear spaces
record.context_brief: Topological characterization for finite-codimensional Chebyshev subspaces of C(Q)
record.original_question: Characterize, in purely topological terms, the compact spaces Q for which the real Banach space C_R(Q), or alternatively the complex Banach space C(Q), contains a Chebyshev subspace of finite codimension n >= 1.

evidence.quote: Characterize (topologically) those compact spaces Q for which the real space C_R(Q) [or the complex space C(Q) ] contains a Cebysev subspace of finite codimension n >= 1 .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Q$ be a compact Hausdorff space, and let $C_{\mathbb{R}}(Q)$ (respectively $C(Q)$) denote the Banach space of continuous real-valued (respectively complex-valued) functions on $Q$, equipped with the supremum norm $\|f\| = \sup_{q\in Q} |f(q)|$. A closed linear subspace $M \subseteq C_{\mathbb{R}}(Q)$ (or $M \subseteq C(Q)$) is called a Chebyshev subspace if for every $f$ in the ambient space there exists a unique element $m \in M$ minimizing $\|f - m\|$. Fix an integer $n \geq 1$.

Give a purely topological characterization of those compact Hausdorff spaces $Q$ for which $C_{\mathbb{R}}(Q)$ contains a Chebyshev subspace of codimension exactly $n$. Likewise, give a purely topological characterization of those compact Hausdorff spaces $Q$ for which the complex Banach space $C(Q)$ contains a Chebyshev subspace of codimension exactly $n$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches indicate substantial work on Chebyshev subspaces of finite codimension in C(Q) (e.g., results of Garkavi, and Tsar'kov; Alexandroff double arrow examples) showing that real C(Q) generally lacks Chebyshev subspaces of codimension greater than 1 except in special cases, and various sufficient/necessary conditions are known. However, no complete purely topological characterization of the compact spaces $Q$ admitting such subspaces appears in the literature; the problem is generally regarded as open.

status_evidence.title: Alexandroff's Double Arrow Compact Space and Approximation Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Concerns existence of Chebyshev subspaces of finite codimension in C(Q) for special compact spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for specific compacta, but no full topological characterization is established.

status_evidence.title: Characteristic of Chebyshev subspaces of finite codimension in L1
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations of Chebyshev subspaces of finite codimension are studied in L1; the C(Q) analogue remains an outstanding question.
status_evidence.claim: The analogous problem for C(Q) is referenced as a long-standing question.
